tha-ap368:1.1: Kadambapupphiya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ gacchantam antarāpaṇe / kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ battiṃsavarakkhaṇaṃ // //
tha-ap368:2.1: Nisajja pāsādavare addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ / kadambapupphaṃ paggayha Vipassim abhipūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap368:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap368:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Kadambapupphiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
